title: fix(app-shell): Setup walkthrough rows — one name for Setup, confirms before Disable and before switching a packaged action off, read-only reasons, forced-reset wording

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup 走查建议的界面部分——首页链接与应用切换器统一用 Setup 应用自己的名称；软件包页说明只读原因、禁用前确认、改称「删除软件包」；打包自动化关闭动作前确认、成功后提示、显示对象名称、手机上不再溢出；强制改密页用控制台自己的译文并把字段叫「临时密码」；记录页标签栏可横向滚动并有渐隐提示；info/warning 不再显示成警报橙色；Setup 页眉标签可用键盘打开说明。
- 为什么改：#27521 是 18.3.0 RC 走查的建议卡，分诊要求每行要么做掉、要么建卡、要么给出不做的理由；这里是 Setup 第 1–23 行中只需改 ui 的部分。
- 风险与回滚：只动 ui 文案、确认框和布局，不改 spec、服务端或元数据协议；标签栏和严重度颜色是所有应用共用的渲染器，影响面最大；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`（标签栏滚动与渐隐）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedActionsSection.tsx`（关闭前确认）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`（禁用确认与只读原因）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/ packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.readOnlyReasonAndDisableConfirm-27521.test.tsx`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Setup rows 1–23 of #27521 (row 6 is #27797), worked one by one against `main`. Taken here (ui only):

- **Row 1 — one name for Setup.** Home's apps-strip link and the app switcher's entry now read the Setup app's own served label (`appLabel` over `resolveKeyedI18nLabel`), the name the app header shows, instead of the fixed "System Settings" / "Settings" strings; those strings stay only as the fallback when no app object is in hand. The Settings hub keeps its title: it is a page inside Setup ("All Settings" in the sidebar), not the app.
- **Row 4 (ui half) — info is not an alarm.** A select value `info` or `warning` with no declared colour now reads blue or yellow from `SEMANTIC_COLOR_MAP` (`@object-ui/fields`), instead of the hashed palette slot that drew Notifications' `info` orange. A declared option colour still wins.
- **Row 5 (ui half) — header tags explain themselves from the keyboard.** `ManagedByBadge` already opens its explanation on hover (measured on main); the tag now takes focus (`tabIndex=0`), which opens the same tooltip.
- **Rows 12 and 22 (ui half) — the forced password change.** On `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` the overlay draws its own body (`auth.remediation.password.resetBody`: an administrator set a temporary password) instead of the server's sentence, which repeated the title in English for a French user; the first field is "Temporary password" (`auth.remediation.password.temporary`). An expired password keeps the server's sentence and "Current password". Both keys in all ten packs.
- **Row 13 (ui half) — record tab strips scroll.** A horizontal `page:tabs` strip wider than its box scrolls sideways (`overflow-x-auto`, triggers `shrink-0`) and fades at each edge that hides a tab; `useHorizontalOverflow` (package-private, not exported) re-reads the edge on scroll and resize into `data-overflow`. The bottom rule became an inset shadow so the active underline still draws over it once the strip clips at its padding box. Measured on the user record at 1440: `scrollWidth` 1269 in a 1088 box, cut with no cue before; now it scrolls and reads `end` / `both` / `start`.
- **Row 20 — Packaged automation.** Switching a packaged action off asks first (off stops it everywhere it is offered); switching on runs at once. An accepted switch, action or flow, says so in a toast; a refused one keeps its verbatim refusal and no toast. The Object column shows the object's label (`useObjectLabel`) over the machine name. On a phone the fixed column widths apply from `sm` up, long machine names break, and cells pad less: measured at 390, both tables went from `scrollWidth` 523 / 537 in a 342 box to 342 / 342. Not touched: #27504's question (whether a switched-off action's button stays on the record page).
- **Row 21 — Packages.** The sheet says why a read-only package offers no write action: loaded from code (`scope: 'project'`), read-only here (scope-less read-only), or part of the platform (system / cloud, reworded from "platform kernel package"). Disable asks first; Enable runs at once. "Delete app" becomes "Delete package" (key `engine.packages.detail.deletePackage`). Installed Apps gets its own subtitle.

Fixed on main, not changed here:

- **Row 16, name derivation** — New Permission Set derives Name from Label on main (`createDerive` slugify on `permission`; typing "Field Ops Lead" fills `field_ops_lead`).
- **Row 18** — the Add user picker shows email beside name: landed by #27808 (card 27433) while this branch was open; the merge took main's version.

Carded, filed from the paragraphs in the `os-dev-report` comment on #27521: rows 2 (#27853), 3 (#27854), 4 rest (#27855), 10 Create User half (#27857), 12 Create User result line (#27858), 13 rest (#27859), 14 (#27861, #27862), 15 columns (#27863), 16 field order and stacked messages (#27864, #27865), 17 (#27866, too large for this PR), 19 (#27867), 22 rest (#27869). Each one's text, labels or layout comes from server or spec metadata (`service-settings` manifests, `platform-objects`, `plugin-auth`, `packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts`), or is its own ui card (row 14's registry-label read face, row 16's stacked messages in `ResourceEditPage`, row 17's grid).

Will not do:

- **Row 5, empty states** — Sharing Rules and Webhooks open on their "Active" view, which filters `active = true`; "No records match this view's filter" is the accurate sentence there, and first-run copy would misstate a view that hides inactive rows.
- **Row 15, hover-only row actions** — the reveal on hover, focus-within, selection and coarse pointers is the grid-wide pattern of every list in the product (`RowActionMenu`, `data-table`); changing it for Setup alone would split one pattern in two.

Later, separate PR: rows 7, 8, 9, 10 (Invite half), 11 and 23 touch the Invitations surface. #27797 is blocked behind server card #27843, so these rows wait for #27843 to land.

## Tests

New: `ManagedByBadge.keyboard-27521`, `badge-severity-27521`, `page-tabs-overflow-cue-27521`, `PackagesPage.readOnlyReasonAndDisableConfirm-27521`, a describe in `RemediationOverlay.passwordResetRequired-12365`, §6 of `PackagedActionsSection.test`, a case in `AppSwitcher.homeMenu-12605`. Existing pins updated for the new words: "Delete package", "Temporary password", the switch-off confirm (`switchOff` helper), the Setup link's label.

## Acceptance notes

- `@object-ui/i18n`'s `de-quote-pairing-3876` pins an exact count of quoted spans in the de pack; the new de strings follow the pack's own unquoted `{{label}}` form for the flow switch, so the count stands.
- The tab-strip fade is a CSS mask on the sticky strip, so the strip's own background fades with the tabs at that edge.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `engine.packages.detail.deleteApp` is renamed `engine.packages.detail.deletePackage`; no other reader of the old key exists in the tree.
